title: Text: B Sakowski ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: Took the best player and the best fit at 1, adding a potential middle-order monster who you can write into the #3 hole for a decade. That’s the guy you needed in the system and that’s the guy you got.
searchText: took the best player and the best fit at 1, adding a potential middle-order monster who you can write into the #3 hole for a decade. that’s the guy you needed in the system and that’s the guy you got. dingler was a first rounder on many boards, rare athleticism behind the plate with a 70 arm, catch-and-throw is excellent, has projectable power, he’s been constantly coming along with the bat. loved cabrera at 62, there’s a good chance that dude hits and does it quickly, not a super high end upside but a good chance for an everyday big leaguer. cruz has interesting hitting tools from both sides of the plate, good power there, solid athlete who likely plays 2nd base or maybe 3rd. b sakowski
